parameters.query: SELECT l.fee_per_player, t.id AS tid, t.code, t.name, t.status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.registration_deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS deadline, (t.registration_deadline < NOW()) AS closed, (t.start_date <= CURDATE()) AS started, t.area, t.city, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(g.name) FROM tournament_grounds g WHERE g.tournament_id = t.id) AS grounds, p.upi_id, p.upi_name, p.qr_key, p.note AS pay_note, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', d.id, 'name', d.name, 'min_age', d.min_age, 'max_age', d.max_age, 'squad_min', d.squad_min, 'squad_max', d.squad_max, 'max_teams', d.max_teams, 'approved', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = d.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED'), 'waiting', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = d.id AND e.status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITLISTED')))) FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, tm.code AS team_code, tm.name AS team_name, e.status AS entry_status, e.division_id AS team_division, e.paid_players, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entry_players ep WHERE ep.entry_id = e.id) AS squad_count, (SELECT cu.name FROM app_users cu WHERE cu.phone = $3) AS coach_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coach_web_pins cp JOIN app_users cu ON cu.id = cp.user_id WHERE cu.phone = $3) AS coach_has_pin, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries ce JOIN app_users ru ON ru.id = ce.registered_by WHERE ce.tournament_id = t.id AND ru.phone = $3) AS coach_team_count FROM tournament_web_links l JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = l.tournament_id LEFT JOIN tournament_payment_details p ON p.tournament_id = t.id LEFT JOIN teams tm ON tm.code = $2 LEFT JOIN tournament_entries e ON e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.team_id = tm.id WHERE l.slug = $1
